ValidationRule.description: PacPoint: RdG - Case# 8405 - REAC Application Must have Active Dependent Application OR Dependent License
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( LicenseType__r.DependencyRequired__c, LicenseType__r.SoleProp__c = false, ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'REAC - Reactivation'), ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'HC - Application Completed'), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(DependentApplication__c)) && ISBLANK(DependentApplication__r.CurrentLicense__c), ISBLANK(DependentApplication__c) && ISBLANK(DependentLicense__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must have either an active Dependent Application or a Dependent License
